title: Authenticated Runner Dispatch & Run Credential Vault Live Proof
goal: Verify that credentials discovered in one phase are safely stored in the vault and seamlessly injected into a follow-up runner task (like ZAP/Nuclei) addressing gap XT-032.
scope: Integration test validating vault lifecycle, redaction, and runner payload injection.
generation_reason: Credential chaining is high risk and needs live proof to guarantee credentials aren't leaked in logs or DB plaintext.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Do not modify the vault encryption mechanism, only test its end-to-end usage.

success_criteria: Test executes discovery runner that finds a token.
Test executes Nuclei runner with injected token.
Logs and DB are audited post-run to ensure token is redacted/encrypted.

acceptance_criteria: Chaining test passes and regex log search confirms no plaintext credential leakage.

out_of_scope: Adding new credential types to the vault
